name: Ancient Lacewing Dragon
biography: Draconis arthromorphae. An ancient lacewing dragon — a cathedral-sized weaver whose silk breath cocoons armies and whose marionette threads reach 120 feet. Habitat: Forest & Jungle.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The dragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

features.name: Stitching Prey
features.description: Some of the dragon's actions cause a hit creature to be threaded. A threaded creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet. A creature stops being threaded when it or a creature within 5 feet of it cuts the threads by hitting them (AC 5) with an attack that deals Slashing damage.

features.name: Web Walker
features.description: The dragon ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing, and it knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Needleclaw attacks.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) Poison damage.

features.name: Needleclaw
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +15, reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) Piercing damage, and the target is threaded (see Stitching Prey trait).

features.name: Silk Breath (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 21 Dexterity, each creature in a 90-foot Cone. Failure: 42 (12d6) Poison damage, and the target is threaded (see Stitching Prey trait). While threaded in this way, the target is Restrained. Success: Half damage only.

features.name: Thread Pull
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 21 Strength, one threaded creature within 120 feet. Failure: The target is moved up to 60 feet in a direction of the dragon's choice and knocked Prone. Success: The target is knocked Prone only.

features.name: Pounce (Legendary Action)
features.description:
Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Needleclaw attack.

features.name: Puppeteer (Legendary Action)
features.description: The dragon moves a threaded creature up to 30 feet in any direction. The creature then makes one melee weapon attack against a target of the dragon's choice within range. The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

features.name: Strangling Silk (Legendary Action)
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 21 Constitution, each threaded creature within 90 feet of the dragon. Failure: 18 (4d8) Slashing damage. Failure or Success: The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
